Alaska, on the other hand, is perfectly at home center stage. She holds court, acts as the gravitational center, and manages to give herself some A+ material–ballads, scenery chewing, and gowns galore–while also leaving a great deal of space for all the other drag performers to shine.

This celebration of gender-bending camp is more polished, and entertaining, than you might expect, with an original score that's heavily influenced by guitar-forward pop-rock as well as contemporary musical theatre.

cn.t: Critics celebrate this glittery musical as a delightful, entertaining spectacle, praising its fabulous performances, eye-catching production values, and heartfelt celebration of drag culture backed by strong vocals and original songs.
